production.order: Per scene: generate THIS first (the hand low, touching the near thing), review it, then THAT as an edit that changes only the free arm and the head (a generated THAT hand tends to reach the target: A1 2.5 chair, 2026-09-19), then the colour swaps as edits of the reviewed pair. Inspect each at 900/360/250/180 px: the fingertip direction is unambiguous, a clear gap separates it from the far thing, five fingers, the near thing still held in THAT, the far thing readable at 180 px, nothing new appears.

shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, not on signs, screens, clothes, bags, machines or vehicles. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.solo: Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.daytime: It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.
shared_prompts.near_far_scene: The meaning of the photo is NEAR versus FAR. Exactly two things of the same kind are in the photo, and they differ only in color. The near one is with the person in the left part of the photo, large and sharp. The far one stands alone in the right third of the photo, clearly farther away, against a plain wall with nothing else around it; it is in focus and easy to recognize even on a small phone screen, and its center is about three quarters of the way across the photo, well clear of the right edge. The camera is at chest height and sees the whole scene from the side, so that the space between the person and the far thing runs from left to right across the photo: an arm pointed at the far thing would be seen side-on as a long line across the photo, never pointing toward the camera. The floor and wall between them are plain and empty. There is no mirror, no picture on the wall, no shelf of objects, and no third thing of that kind anywhere.

assets.item: This one is red. / This bag is red, (turn 1)
assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Ana. Keep her face, long dark wavy hair, light-olive skin and build exactly. Create a new photograph of her: she stands in her bright living room in her sage-green overshirt over a white top and jeans. She stands in the left third of the photo, her body turned a little toward the right side of the photo, her face visible in three-quarter view. With the hand nearer the camera she holds a large RED canvas tote bag by its handles, low at her side, so the red bag hangs beside her close to the camera, large and sharp. She looks down at the red bag and touches the front of it with the tip of the index finger of her other hand; that arm stays bent and low, close to her body. Across the room, in the right third of the photo, about four meters away from her, one BLUE canvas tote bag of the same shape and size sits alone on the seat of a light wooden chair against a plain white wall. The blue bag is clearly smaller than the red one because it is far away, but it is in focus and easy to recognize, about one fifth of the photo width.

assets.item: That one is blue. / but that bag is blue. (turn 2)
assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Ana: she holds a red tote bag by its handles in one hand and touches it with her other index finger, and a blue tote bag on a wooden chair stands alone across the room. Change only two things. First, her free arm (the one that touched the red bag) is now raised and stretched out straight at shoulder height toward the blue bag, with her index finger pointing at it and the other fingers curled; the whole arm and the pointing hand are clearly visible, seen from the side against the plain wall, and the fingertip stays far away from the blue bag, with a wide empty gap between them. The arm stays at shoulder height and does not reach down or forward to it. Second, she turns her head and looks at the blue bag. The red bag stays exactly where it was, still held by her other hand, close to the camera.
